data.name: Avion
data.gender_notes: Avion is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Avion was a god of the winds and birds of prey, often depicted as an eagle. His Roman equivalent was the god Jupiter Fulminator, who was also associated with birds of prey and the storm. The name Avion carries the meaning “Bird of prey” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Avion usually hope their child will grow to embody bird of prey and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Avion belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bird of prey.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avion total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אביון
in_hebrew.meaning: אביון - שם פרטי שמשמעותו אב צעיר או עני
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אביון הוא שם פרטי עברי שמשמעותו אב צעיר או עני. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'אב' שפירושו אבא או אב, ו'יון' שפירושו עני או צעיר. השם אביון מופיע בתנ"ך ככינוי לאחד משבטי ישראל, אך לא כשהוא משמש כשם פרטי לאדם. עם זאת, השם הפך להיות בשימוש כשהוא נושא משמעות של עוני או צניעות.

in_greek.name: Αβίων
in_greek.meaning: Αβίων - όνομα που σημαίνει φτωχός ή νεαρός πατέρας
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αβίων είναι μια ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος אביון, που σημαίνει φτωχός ή νεαρός πατέρας. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα αυτό μπορεί να συνδέεται με την έννοια της πνευματικής φτώχειας ή της ταπείνωσης, που είναι μια κοινή θεματική στην πρώιμη Χριστιανική εκκλησία.

in_latin.name: Avion
in_latin.meaning: Avion - name meaning poor or young father
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Avion is derived from the Hebrew אביון, meaning poor or young father. In the Latin tradition, this name may have been adopted to signify humility or spiritual poverty, which was highly valued in early Christian communities. The name's etymology reflects a deep connection to biblical values of modesty and simplicity.

in_english.name: Avion
in_english.meaning: Avion - a Christian name meaning poor or young father
in_english.long_meaning: The Christian name Avion is derived from the Hebrew אביון (Avion), which means 'poor' or 'young father.' This name carries significant spiritual connotations, reflecting values of humility and modesty highly esteemed in Christian tradition. Historically, the name may be linked to biblical themes of spiritual poverty and the pursuit of righteousness. In modern Christian cultures, Avion is chosen for its unique blend of traditional and contemporary appeal, symbolizing a connection to biblical heritage and Christian values.

data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, the name Avion can be linked spiritually with the concept of elevation and ascent. Pilots guide their aircraft, or metaphorically their lives, from a bird's eye view, granting them a new perspective on the world. Additionally, the Christian journey symbolizes the ascent towards spiritual enlightenment, as we take flight in faith and leave our earthly concerns behind. The name Avion may serve as a constant reminder to soar higher and remain focused on our divine destinies.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Avion, meaning "bird of God" in Latin, symbolizes the ascension and soaring above earthly concerns towards the divine. It emphasizes the spiritual journey, as a Christian seeks to elevate their soul towards the heavens, leaving behind the mundane world.
